text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Can I ask you for the ultimate
favor?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Okay! I want you to massage my
shoulders! I have
a huuuge headache.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll be able to pound all that
pain away
with your love for me!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Look, even when I try this... Pain, pain,
go away...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Urgh... Why'd I do that?! Now it hurts... even more than this morning...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I make Маяно Топ Ган take
some
medicine for her headache, but it
doesn't go
away...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
